name: DES DV Monthly Reporting — Initial Prototype
livePromotion: Hold. Do not update live code or publish without explicit authorization.
integration: Reports page. IT Admin only outside View as User during rule validation. When promoting later, merge only reporting integration into App.tsx and preserve existing live role-access integration.
confirmedRules: Reporting year October 1 through September 30; continuing enrollments count again on October 1.
One first count per linked Client Profile per reporting year, across all programs; a DV Outreach first count allows one later count upon transfer to any other program.
Use TANF eligibility from Program Enrollment and derive age from linked Client Profile Date of Birth.
Shelter Occupancy derives nights from bed enrollment dates within the selected period; open stays use the current date.
Combine transitional housing under normal Autumn House and Faith House names.
reviewableDefaults: Adult age is 18 at the first count; missing/invalid DOB is flagged.
Enrolled/Re-Enrolled only for People Served; waiting lists and turnaways excluded.
TANF Yes and No choice labels; missing/N/A eligibility flagged rather than guessed.
Non-TANF children excluded and flagged pending user confirmation; configurable in Report Setup.
Check-in included, checkout/current day excluded; no future or unfinished bed nights.
Count each distinct bed enrollment; overlapping client stays flagged. Optional client-night deduplication is available in setup.
Same-day enrollment ties prefer non-outreach, then Dataverse row ID.
Archived records excluded; missing/unresolved links flagged.
frontend: Date filters, editable per-preview counting rules, explicit review before running, progress/cancel, full-page reads, record-level audit paging, summary/audit CSV and rule JSON downloads. No source-record writes or persistent counted flags.
